articles.title: Revolut hackers demand $3 million in Monero, threaten to sell customer data
articles.snippet: The group gave Revolut 24 hours to pay and said it targeted customers with significant crypto holdings.

articles.title: Fed raises rates by 25 basis points in first hike since July 2023
articles.snippet: The widely expected move places the U.S. Federal Reserve's benchmark fed funds rate range at 3.75%-4.0%.

articles.title: U.S. House's tax committee advances crypto tax bill in wake of Clarity Act loss
articles.snippet: The Digital Asset Tax Certainty Act would ease complicated tax burdens for everyday use of cryptocurrencies, though Trump's industry ties spurred some pushback.

articles.title: Payward plans to offer U.S. clients onchain perpetual futures on Hyperliquid
articles.snippet: Leveraging its $550 million acquisition of Bitnomial, Payward aims to become the first registered U.S. exchange to deploy markets on the Hyperliquid protocol.

articles.title: Blockchain finance platform Theo launches tokenized silver backed by $40 million in active leases
articles.snippet: The onchain finance platform said thSLVR allows investors to retain exposure to silver while earning income from lending the metal to institutional borrowers.
